tools.name: bundle_analyze
tools.description: Read-only size analysis of a dist directory.

tools.name: code_explorer_ask
tools.description: Consult CodeExplorer for a query or code understanding request. Returns related files, dependent symbols, tests to watch, and technical recommendations. This is a read-only tool.

query.description: The query or task description to ask CodeExplorer about.

repo.description: Indexed repository path or id. Defaults to the graph that contains the current working directory.

tools.name: code_graph
tools.description: Query the code dependency graph: find callers/callees, impact analysis, generate Mermaid flowcharts, class hierarchies, and dependency paths. Use this when the user asks about code relationships, who calls what, what would break if something changes, or wants a diagram/flowchart of the code.

query.description: Function, class, or module name (fuzzy matched)

tools.name: code_stats
tools.description: Compute code statistics for a directory.

tools.name: codebase_map
tools.description: Build and query a map of the codebase structure, symbols, dependencies, and code graph. Graph operations query the persistent code knowledge graph for import relationships, component locations, architecture layers, and dependency paths.

query.description: Search query for finding relevant context, or entity name for graph operations (e.g. 'agent-executor', 'CodeBuddyAgent')

node_type.description: Filter by node type for graph_query (e.g. 'module', 'agent', 'tool', 'middleware')

deep.description: Perform deep analysis including symbols and dependencies (slower)

tools.name: community_search
tools.description: Search what people say — Hacker News, Stack Overflow, GitHub, arXiv and Reddit — ranked by real engagement (votes, points, stars) over a recent window. Complements web_search, which indexes what publishers write. Free, no API key required.

query.description: What to look for. Plain words work best — this searches discussions, not pages.

days.description: How far back to look, in days (1-365, default 30). Beyond ~30 it stops being current.

limit.description: How many results to return (1-60, default 25)

sources.description: Restrict to specific sources. All by default.

tools.name: csv_preview
tools.description: Preview CSV columns, rows, and inferred types.

tools.name: dep_inspect
tools.description: Inspect package.json dependencies, scripts, engines, and lockfile presence with no network access.

tools.name: design_system
tools.description: List available brand design systems and read DESIGN.md guidance for UI generation.

query.description: Optional search over id, name, category, and tagline for action='list'.

tools.name: diff_files
tools.description: Unified diff between two files under root.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search project documentation for architecture, API, security, and configuration information. Read-only local docs lookup — not a web search.

tools.name: env_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose project environment read-only.

tools.name: file_search
tools.description: Regex search in files under a bounded root. If root is omitted, searches process.cwd() (the launch folder), not the git toplevel.

root.description: Directory to search. Optional; defaults to the current working directory (the folder the process was launched from). Relative paths resolve against that folder.

tools.name: find_bugs
tools.description: Scan source files for potential bugs using regex-based static analysis. Detects null access patterns, unchecked errors, resource leaks, race conditions, security issues (eval, innerHTML, SQL injection), and dead code. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, and Java.

path.description: File or directory path to scan for bugs

tools.name: find_definition
tools.description: Find the definition of a symbol (where it's declared). Returns the file, line, and signature.

symbol_name.description: The symbol name to find the definition for

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find all references/usages of a symbol in the codebase. Useful for understanding how a function, class, or variable is used.

symbol_name.description: The symbol name to find references for

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before/after each match (default: 2)

tools.name: find_symbols
tools.description: Find code symbols (functions, classes, interfaces, types, constants) by name. Useful for understanding code structure and finding definitions.

name.description: Symbol name or partial name to search for

types.description: Types of symbols to find (default: all types)

tools.name: get_todo_list
tools.description: Get the current todo list to see all tasks and their status

tools.name: git_summary
tools.description: Read-only git repository summary.

tools.name: http_probe
tools.description: GET loopback-only URL and return status, headers and size.

tools.name: internet_scout_plan
tools.description:
Plan an evidence-first web navigation workflow before browsing.

Use this when a task involves advanced internet research, OSINT-style public source review, prospecting, profile enrichment, page verification, or multi-step web surfing.

The plan sequences web_search, web_fetch, browser.observe, browser.extract, browser.assert_text, relationship_context, remember, and lessons_add where appropriate. It also returns stop conditions for captcha, login walls, paywalls, 403/429, rate limits, and access-control bypass requests.

goal.description: What to learn, verify, or collect from public/user-authorized web sources.

query.description: Optional search query. Defaults to goal.

sourceUrl.description: Known starting URL. If omitted, the plan starts with web_search.

requiresInteraction.description: Whether clicks, forms, tabs, or scrolling are likely needed before extraction.

expectedText.description: Text expected on the page; adds browser.assert_text to the plan.

persistWhenProven.description: Add remember/lessons_add only after durable evidence is proven.

maxPages.description: Maximum public pages to inspect. Defaults to 5.

allowLoginPages.description: Allow user-authorized login pages to be opened, without credential/captcha bypass.

tools.name: json_query
tools.description: Query a JSON file using a simple dotted path.

tools.name: knowledge_graph
tools.description: Query the in-memory code knowledge graph for entity relationships (imports, calls, extends, exports). Actions: query, add, subgraph, path, stats. Distinct from code_graph (static analysis over the repo).

subject.description: Triple subject (entity name, e.g. "src/index.ts", "MyClass"). Used by query and add.

predicate.description: Triple predicate (relationship type: imports, exports, calls, extends, implements, dependsOn, contains, definedIn, usedBy, typeof). Used by query and add.

object.description: Triple object (target entity). Used by query and add.

metadata.description: Optional metadata key-value pairs for add action.

maxDepth.description: Max path length for path finding (default: 5).

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the agent knowledge base for domain knowledge, conventions, or procedures. Returns ranked excerpts from loaded Knowledge.md files.

query.description: Keywords or phrase to search for in knowledge bases

tools.name: lead_scout_enrichment_plan
tools.description: Plan a multi-hop public B2B enrichment job: profile page -> official website -> contact/legal/about pages -> phone/email/contact URL, with principles, evidence chain, and a protected run_script contract.

goal.description: Enrichment objective, e.g. find architect phones by following official website links.

sourceUrlField.description: Field containing the seed profile/directory URL. Defaults to source_url.

websiteField.description: Field containing or receiving the official website URL. Defaults to site_web.

nameField.description: Field containing the business/person name. Defaults to nom.

missingFields.description: Fields to enrich. Defaults to email, telephone, and site_web.

maxHops.description: Maximum evidence hops from source profile to official site/contact pages. Defaults to 3.

pageBudget.description: Maximum public pages per lead for the generated script. Defaults to 8; validation accepts 1 to 30.

delayMs.description: Delay between requests in the generated script. Defaults to 1500ms.

allowedDomains.description: Optional domain allowlist. Empty means public web except ignored domains.

ignoredDomains.description: Additional domains to treat as generic portals or off-limits.

allowGeneratedScript.description: Include the generated Python script in the output. Defaults true.

tools.name: lead_scout_lesson_candidates
tools.description: Generate reviewed lesson candidates from Lead Scout runs or sandboxed enrichment scripts. Returns lessons_add payloads but does not persist them automatically.

goal.description: Lead Scout task or run goal that produced observations.

context.description: Optional lesson context label, e.g. "Lead Scout architect enrichment".

needsPublicEnrichment.description: Selected leads with no email, phone, or website.

stats.description: Run stats such as processed, enriched, skipped, blocked, selectedLeads, needsPublicEnrichment, and contact coverage.

warnings.description: Warnings from a Lead Scout run.

blockers.description: Safety or access blockers observed, such as captcha, login, 403, 429.

successfulPatterns.description: Patterns that worked and may be reusable.

failedPatterns.description: Patterns that failed and should not be retried blindly.

contactPathsThatWorked.description: Same-domain contact paths that yielded public contact data.

domainsToIgnore.description: Generic or non-official domains to ignore in future enrichment.

scriptChanges.description: Potential generated-script improvements observed during the run.

tools.name: lead_scout_plan
tools.description: Build a safe B2B lead-discovery plan for public professional data: sources, schema, scoring, script recipe, evidence requirements, and human-review gates.

goal.description: Prospecting objective, e.g. find architects near a city for a renovation offer.

customTarget.description: Custom B2B lead category label when target is custom.

zone.description: Geographic scope such as city, postal code, department, region, or radius text.

offer.description: Offer or service to qualify leads against.

maxProspects.description: Maximum lead budget for review. Defaults to 50; tool validation accepts 1 to 500.

sources.description: Optional source strategy. Defaults depend on target.

exportFormats.description: Desired review output formats. Defaults to csv and json.

localDatasetPaths.description: Existing CSV/JSON lead datasets to import before web discovery.

requireHumanApprovalBeforeContact.description: Whether a human must approve source evidence and outreach before contact. Defaults true.

tools.name: lessons_graph
tools.description: Build a mini-Obsidian concept graph over lessons.md. Derives concepts from [[wiki links]], Markdown links, #tags, context, related/tags metadata, and keywords, then returns nearby lessons and connected notions.

query.description: Optional text filter before graphing lessons

concept.description: Only graph lessons linked to this concept slug, label, wiki link, or Markdown target

includeKeywords.description: Whether to include fallback keyword concepts. Set false for a cleaner explicit-link/tag graph.

tools.name: lessons_list
tools.description: List all lessons learned, optionally filtered by category. Shows lesson content, category, timestamps, and decay scores.

tools.name: lessons_search
tools.description: Search lessons learned for relevant patterns, rules, or context before starting a task. Helps avoid repeating past mistakes.

query.description: Search terms to match against lessons

tools.name: license_check
tools.description: Read-only dependency license check from node_modules.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories at a given path. Returns name, type, size, and modification time. Auto-approved read-only operation.

path.description: Directory path to list (default: current directory)

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.description: Resolve the semantic definition of a symbol using the configured language server. Read-only. Provide either symbol or both 1-based line and column.

file.description: Path to the source file, relative to the active workspace or absolute

symbol.description: Symbol name to locate in the file; use line and column for ambiguous occurrences

line.description: 1-based line number; must be paired with column

column.description: 1-based column number; must be paired with line

tools.name: lsp_diagnostics
tools.description: Return diagnostics published by the configured language server for a source file. Read-only; distinguishes a clean file from an unavailable server.

file.description: Path to the source file, relative to the active workspace or absolute

tools.name: lsp_hover
tools.description: Return semantic hover/type information from the configured language server. Read-only. Provide either symbol or both 1-based line and column.

file.description: Path to the source file, relative to the active workspace or absolute

symbol.description: Symbol name to locate in the file; use line and column for ambiguous occurrences

line.description: 1-based line number; must be paired with column

column.description: 1-based column number; must be paired with line

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.description: Find semantic references to a symbol using the configured language server. Read-only. Provide either symbol or both 1-based line and column.

file.description: Path to the source file, relative to the active workspace or absolute

symbol.description: Symbol name to locate in the file; use line and column for ambiguous occurrences

line.description: 1-based line number; must be paired with column

column.description: 1-based column number; must be paired with line

tools.name: lsp_symbols
tools.description: Return the semantic document outline (classes, functions, methods, variables, and nested symbols) from the configured language server. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the source file, relative to the active workspace or absolute

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check if a loopback port is available.

tools.name: project_map
tools.description: Summarize a project tree, languages, likely entrypoints, and file/directory counts.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read file contents with optional 1-indexed line range. Hermes-compatible alias for view_file.

path.description: Path to file or directory to view

start_line.description: Starting line number for partial file view (optional)

end_line.description: Ending line number for partial file view (optional)

tools.name: reason
tools.description: Solve complex problems using Tree-of-Thought reasoning with Monte Carlo Tree Search. Use this for planning, architecture decisions, debugging complex issues, or any task requiring structured multi-step reasoning. Returns a reasoning tree with scored solution paths.

problem.description: The problem statement or question to reason about

context.description: Additional context, constraints, or background information

constraints.description: Constraints that the solution must satisfy

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve a specific memory entry by its key.

tools.name: relationship_context
tools.description: Build a safe relationship/world-memory context card for a person, organization, place, or concept. Uses public facts, relationship memory, evidence, confidence, and permissions without performing web search or identification by itself.

subject.description: Name or label of the entity being discussed.

publicFacts.description: Public or encyclopedic facts safe to use when permitted.

relationshipFacts.description: Private relationship memory, used only for confirmed known people.

sensitiveFacts.description: Sensitive facts withheld unless explicitly permitted.

visibleSignals.description: Visible, non-identifying context such as badge text or current setting.

evidence.description: Evidence attached to public facts or recognition.

permissions.description: Explicit permissions controlling what context may be used.

tools.name: sbom_generate
tools.description: Generate a minimal JSON SBOM from node_modules package metadata.

tools.name: screen_memory
tools.description: Recall what was on the user's screen, said, or heard by querying a local screenpipe instance (24/7 screen+audio history). Read-only; results are secret/PII-redacted. Requires screenpipe running locally (SCREENPIPE_URL, default http://localhost:3030).

query.description: Natural-language search over screen+audio history (omit for most recent).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Unified search tool for finding text content or files (similar to Cursor's search)

query.description: Text to search for or file name/path pattern

include_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to include (e.g. '*.ts', '*.js')

exclude_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude (e.g. '*.log', 'node_modules')

case_sensitive.description: Whether search should be case sensitive (default: false)

whole_word.description: Whether to match whole words only (default: false)

regex.description: Whether query is a regex pattern (default: false)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

include_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden files (default: false)

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for text content or files. Hermes-compatible alias for search.

query.description: Text to search for or file name/path pattern

include_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to include (e.g. '*.ts', '*.js')

exclude_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude (e.g. '*.log', 'node_modules')

case_sensitive.description: Whether search should be case sensitive (default: false)

whole_word.description: Whether to match whole words only (default: false)

regex.description: Whether query is a regex pattern (default: false)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

include_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden files (default: false)

tools.name: search_multi
tools.description: Search for multiple patterns at once with OR (any pattern) or AND (all patterns) logic.

patterns.description: Array of patterns to search for

tools.name: self_describe
tools.description: Inspect this robot/agent's implementation and evidenced turn metadata: package/revision, relevant code areas, model/provider/surface, registered versus currently exposed tools, configuration-only faculties, and explicit limits. It performs no live hardware, process, service, or network probes; unavailable attestations remain unknown. Optional operation=list/read/search explores attested implementation files under src/ or dist/ with paths and line numbers; no arbitrary workspace access. Use it for technical introspection and questions about current settings (theme, model, provider, permissions, turn limits) and capabilities. Its output is a verifiable operational self-model, never evidence of subjective consciousness.

path.description: Relative core implementation path. Default src/ in a checkout, dist/ in an installed package.

query.description: Literal text for search, never a shell command or regex.

offset.description: Zero-based list offset. Use returned nextOffset to continue a truncated directory listing.

line.description: First line to read; returns at most 120 lines.

focus.description: The aspect of this agent to inspect, for example voice, memory, routing, architecture, or a current limitation.

tools.name: session_search
tools.description:
Search saved Code Buddy sessions by title or message content.

Use this to recover previous conversations, decisions, and context from the real
local session store. Results include session metadata and a compact match
snippet; full transcripts can then be opened with the CLI session commands or
session history flows.

Example: Find sessions that discussed a Hermes tool
{ "query": "Hermes session_search", "limit": 5 }

query.description: Full-text query to search in saved session titles and messages

tools.name: sessions_history
tools.description:
Get the conversation history of a session.

Use this to understand what happened in another session before sending a message.

You can identify sessions by:
- sessionKey: Human-readable key like "main", "spawn:abc:task1"
- sessionId: UUID of the session

Example: Get last 20 messages from main session
{ "sessionKey": "main", "limit": 20, "includeTools": false }

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description:
List active sessions in the multi-agent system.

Use this to discover other sessions you can communicate with.

Session kinds:
- main: Main DM session with user
- channel: Channel/group session
- cron: Scheduled cron job session
- hook: Webhook-triggered session
- spawn: Spawned sub-agent session
- node: Companion node session

Example: List all active sessions from the last 10 minutes
{ "activeMinutes": 10, "limit": 20 }

activeMinutes.description: Only sessions active in last N minutes

messageLimit.description: Include last N messages per session in preview

tools.name: skill_view
tools.description: Read one local skill from the hub, bundled package, built-in specializations or workspace, with metadata and optional instructions.

include_content.description: Include SKILL.md file content. Default: true.

tools.name: skills_list
tools.description: List local skills: bundled, built-in, workspace and hub-installed. Use availableSkills for usable skills; unavailableSkills gives disabled/missing/modified records. Read-only; no remote search.

include_usage.description: Include local usage telemetry when present. Default: true.

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: Get a real stock or index market quote (price, change, day range, volume) via Yahoo Finance / Nasdaq (free, no API key). ALWAYS use this tool (never web_search) for stock price / cours de bourse / market index questions.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol. US stocks plain (e.g. 'AAPL', 'TSLA', 'NVDA'); other exchanges suffixed (e.g. 'MC.PA' for LVMH, 'BMW.DE'); indices prefixed with ^ (e.g. '^FCHI' for CAC 40, '^GSPC' for S&P 500). Map the company/index name the user says to its ticker.

tools.name: todo_scan
tools.description: Scan a project for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search for available tools by keyword. Use this when the tool you need is not in your current tool list — it returns matching tool names and descriptions (and loads deferred schemas).

query.description: Search query — keywords describing what you need to do.

tools.name: user_model_recall
tools.description: Recall what is known about the user (accepted observations only) to tailor your approach. Optionally filter by kind or a keyword query. Read-only: never proposes or writes observations.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter accepted observations

tools.name: view_file
tools.description: View contents of a file or list directory contents. Read/inspect a file before editing it — never guess its contents.

path.description: Path to file or directory to view

start_line.description: Starting line number for partial file view (optional)

end_line.description: Ending line number for partial file view (optional)

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Get current weather and forecast for a city via Open-Meteo (no API key). Returns temperature, feels-like, sky condition, wind and humidity, plus a daily forecast. ALWAYS use this tool (never web_search) for weather/météo/forecast questions.

location.description: City name as the user said it (e.g. 'Paris', 'La Roche-sur-Yon')

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Fetch and extract text content from a web page URL. Hermes-compatible alias for web_fetch.

url.description: The URL of the web page to fetch

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch and read the full content of a web page URL. Use this after web_search to get the actual article content, news details, or information. Always summarize the fetched content for the user.

url.description: The URL of the web page to fetch

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.description: Scrape a web page locally with Scrapling. Supports fast HTTP extraction, stealth/Cloudflare browser mode, dynamic JavaScript rendering, and CSS selectors. Falls back to web_fetch when Scrapling is unavailable.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to scrape

css.description: Named CSS selectors to extract, for example { title: 'h1', prices: '.price' }

impersonate.description: Optional browser identity for HTTP mode

solveCloudflare.description: Attempt Cloudflare challenge handling in stealth mode

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Returns URLs and snippets. IMPORTANT: After getting search results, you MUST call web_fetch on the most relevant URL(s) to get the actual content and provide a detailed answer to the user. Never just return links - always fetch and summarize the content.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)
